system.description: Your art is considered truly inspired and inspiring, moving others with an uncanny essence of life and beauty. The difficulty of all Expression rolls is reduced by two; if the art relates to God, the Church, or similarly high ideals, the difficulty is reduced by three instead. Such perfection can engender jealousy in mortal or Cainite rivals, and suspicious clergy may suspect you of having sold your soul or committed hubris.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans
